recommendation: Keep the source-changing commit as-is. It restores missing applied mapping content in current build-scope source while respecting later accepted Consent model changes; no separate related-issue reconciliation is needed from this investigation.
issue_request: FHIR-12666 was Published/Persuasive and requested HL7 V2 CON mappings for Consent, including category/scope to CON-2 with table 0496, policy and policyRule to CON-3, identifier to CON-4, status to CON-11, dateTime to CON-13, provision.period to CON-14/15, performer to CON-24/25, and source[x] to consent text/background fields.
initial_application: The request was initially applied in 2019 commit 2da480ca699986fa93ba5f234dc5b055146d8144 against the old Consent spreadsheet. Later conversion/refactor history preserved many mappings but FHIR-31903 removed scope, FHIR-32817 split policy/policyRule, and commit 632f4b84972d170c0dfe48c80a7f7afad35c7c66 split performer into grantor/grantee while dropping the CON-24/25 map.
additional_context: Consent is active in source/fhir.ini. The fhir.ini element migration notes identify current successors for the issue-era fields: dateTime to date, policy to policyBasis, policyRule to policyText, scope merged with category, and source[x] split into sourceAttachment/sourceReference. Negative Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant conflicting community evidence.
reconciliation: Edited source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml to add the CON-2 scope-derivation note on category, restore CON-24/25 on grantor, and add CON-3 mappings to policyBasis and policyText. Edited source/consent/valueset-consent-category-example.xml to include http://terminology.hl7.org/ValueSet/v2-0496 and describe HL7 V2 table 0496 in the value set description.
source_changes: source/consent/structuredefinition-Consent.xml: restored current Consent V2 mappings for category CON-2 note, grantor CON-24/25, policyBasis CON-3, and policyText CON-3.
source/consent/valueset-consent-category-example.xml: added the THO v2-0496 value set include and updated the description to mention HL7 V2 table 0496 Consent Type codes.
